llmUsageBar.command.refresh.title: LLM Usage Bar: Refresh Now
llmUsageBar.command.checkForUpdates.titl: LLM Usage Bar: Check for Updates
llmUsageBar.config.checkForUpdates: Check GitHub Releases once a day for a newer version.
llmUsageBar.config.displayFormat: Status bar display format: usage percent, a small bar gauge, or both.
llmUsageBar.config.pollIntervalSeconds: How often to fetch usage data (seconds).
llmUsageBar.config.warnThresholdPercent: Show warning color when any window reaches this usage percent.
llmUsageBar.config.errorThresholdPercent: Show error color when any window reaches this usage percent.
llmUsageBar.config.claude.showSessionCos: Show a pay-as-you-go cost estimate for the active Claude Code session in the tooltip, computed from the local transcript.
llmUsageBar.config.github.enabled: Show GitHub Actions included-minutes usage (uses the GitHub CLI login; billing API needs the "user" scope).
llmUsageBar.config.github.includedMinute: Included GitHub Actions minutes per month. 0 = derive from the account plan (Free 2000 / Pro 3000). Only used when the API does not report the quota itself.
llmUsageBar.config.statusBarWindows: How many usage windows to show in the status bar per provider (the tooltip always shows all). Set 3 to also show model-scoped windows like "7d Fable".
